description: AGSC-09-13: the local tool server answers from the Bundle it is started in, as it is on disk: draft, retired and release-gated items included; it is the author's own tool, not a published surface, and a page tool sees only the listed set of AGSC-09-16. Derivation over the minimal fixture with three items added to the cluster agent-patterns: alder (draft), birch (retired) and cedar (release: autumn, with releases {"autumn": false}). Over standard input (stdio entries, by the id of each tools/call frame) read answers the item envelope for handoff, alder, birch and cedar, and the error envelope AGSC-E301 only for a slug that does not exist. The page tools of the site the same Bundle builds (page entries, one per call) answer handoff and the error envelope AGSC-E301 for alder, birch and cedar, as for a slug that does not exist. The resources the server lists (responses, compared as a subset, a list element by element) are the published items: birch is among them because a retired item keeps its resource (AGSC-00-05, AGSC-09-14b), and alder and cedar are not; sorted by code point, birch falls between agent-patterns and graph.jsonld.
